text: Release tags are annotated (git tag -a) and named <crate>-v<version>, e.g. libsail-v0.3.0 and sail-v0.2.1, since the crates version independently. The libsail 0.3.0 / sail 0.2.1 release was tagged lightweight by mistake and left that way, because converting would mean overwriting tags the remote already had; the --follow-tags flag skips lightweight tags, which is how the mistake surfaced.
